svg.title: Circuit breakers
svg.desc: A seven-slide explainer: a circuit breaker's code shown block by block, its state machine walked, a sequence diagram synced to the machine, the story on a time axis, a refactor to backoff, and a flowchart traced.

g.text: Fail fast while a dependency is down, then check if it's back.

svg.text: The whole thing is one class
The same story, message by message

g.text: Closed: every call waits out the timeout.
Open: calls fail at once, the service gets a rest.
Half-open: one probe succeeds, and traffic flows again.
